scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)
other_conditions: Business/organization must be a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise operating in the manufacturing sector
Production must have started on or after 1 April 2019
Applicant may be from the private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, or a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or the Industrial SHGs
Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) must fall between 1 April 2020 and 31 March 2025
First application must be submitted within 12 months from the DOCCP or within 12 months from the date of notification of Banglashree, whichever is later
benefits_summary: Refund of 30% (Zones B & C) or 50% (Zones D & E) of net SGST paid for up to 8 years, subject to a cumulative cap of 75% of the fixed capital investment.
